### `noya strategies quote`

Quote a strategy at an amount — returns the route, estimates, risk results, blockers, `canOpen`, and an `expiresAt`. A preview strategy still quotes (`canOpen:false`). Required before `openPosition` (read)

| Flag | Value | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--strategy-id` | `<value>` | — | Catalog strategy id to quote. |
| `--amount` | `<value>` | — | Decimal string in the strategy's funding asset (e.g. "5000"); never a JS number. |
| `--spend-cap` | `<value>` | — | Decimal string in the strategy's funding asset (e.g. "5000"); never a JS number. |
